messages.subject: Effect Size Expected Total Score
parts:
Hi Phil

While the command

empirical_ES()
​

provides measures of effect for each of the items under the Meade (2010) proposal. There is some way to estimate the effect for the whole scale from mirt.

I can think of calculating the factor scores in a multigroup model and calculating the d cohen on those scores. This procedure would be correct or is there a more sophisticated one.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards

JV

messages.author: 394838c3712aced6
messages.subject: Re: Effect Size Expected Total Score
parts:
Use

empirical_ES(model, DIF = FALSE)

to get test/bundle-level DTF/DBF statistics.
